fit_complexity: Theta(n*C) validation scan, plus O(n_s*P) screening arithmetic, plus O(n_l*M_r*E + n_l*M*K + T*D*n_l*M), where P=C-1, n_l=min(n,32768), n_s=min(n_l,max(400,40000000/max(P,1))), M<=24, M_r<=38, E<=16, K<=16, T<=36, D<=4
predict_complexity: O(m*(M_r + M*log(K) + T*D)) with the same caps; each row is independent of the other prediction rows
memory_complexity: O(P) moment table during fit plus O(n_l*M_r) working storage, released except a fitted state O(M*K + T*2^D); caller-owned inputs are extra
